content.description:
Market Domination Overtime Host Josh Lipton previews several of the biggest stories to come tomorrow, Thursday, January 22, including President Trump's meeting with European Union (EU) leadership; corporate earnings results from Procter & Gamble (PG), GE Aerospace (GE), and Intel (INTC); and December's Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) index.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination Overtime.
